# Thomson Reuters Tax and Accounting

> > Comprehensive tax, accounting, audit, and financial planning solutions powered by AI-driven tools for accounting professionals and firms.

Thomson Reuters Tax and Accounting provides integrated software and research solutions for tax professionals, accountants, and audit firms. The platform combines traditional tax and accounting tools with AI-powered assistants like CoCounsel and Ready to Advise to automate workflows, enhance compliance, and improve client advisory services.

## Key Topics

- CoCounsel Tax
- CoCounsel Audit
- ONESOURCE
- Cloud Audit Suite
- Tax preparation
- Audit solutions
- Workflow automation
- Tax compliance
- Practice management
- Financial planning
- AI-powered tools
- Tax research
- Accounting firms
- Ready to Advise
- Data management

## AI-Powered Tax and Audit Tools

- [CoCounsel Tax - the AI tax assistant for tax professionals](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/cocounsel-tax): CoCounsel Tax: AI-powered tax assistant for tax professionals.
- [CoCounsel Audit - AI audit tools for audit professionals](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/cocounsel-audit): CoCounsel Audit: AI assistant for audit workflow automation.
- [Tax planning software for accountants | Ready to Advise](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/ready-to-advise): Ready to Advise: AI-powered tax planning software for firms.
- [AI for tax preparation workflow automation | Ready to Review](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/ready-to-review): Ready to Review: Agentic AI for 1040 tax return preparation.
- [Transaction analysis for accounting firms | Audit Intelligence Analyze](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/audit-intelligence-analyze): Audit Intelligence Analyze: AI-powered transaction analysis tool.
